newsitem.title: USA: Depotech starts DepoCyt tests in children.
newsitem.headline: Depotech starts DepoCyt tests in children.

text.p: DepoTech Corp on Wednesday said it has started Phase I clinical trials of anti-cancer drug DepoCyt in pediatric patients with advanced meningeal malignancies.

DepoTech is completing a New Drug Application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for DepoCyt in adult patients with neoplastic meningitis arising from solid tumors. This will be the first study evaluating DepoCyt in children.
The pediatric trial is a multi-center, dose-escalation study assessing the safety of three different dosages of DepoCyt in patients with leukemia, lymphoma or solid tumors.
Up to 30 patients will be enrolled in three groups, organized by age between one and 21 years old.
The study will be conducted under the direction of Drs. Susan M. Blaney and David G. Poplack of the Texas Children's Cancer Center located in Houston.

DepoCyt, being developed with Chiron Corp, is an injectable, sustained release formulation of the chemotherapy agent cytarabine. It is encapsulated in DepoFoam particles, which is DepoTech's proprietary lipid-based drug delivery technology.
